title: Company registry extract and good standing
definition: The official register entry for a company, showing its incorporation, its registered office, its directors and whether it is in good standing, together with the filings it has made. It is requested where a company customer is being assessed, and it establishes what the register says about the entity's existence and status independently of the entity's own account of itself.
evidence_to_cite: the register extract, with the date of retrieval and the register version
the incorporation details, the registered office and the current directors
the filing history, including any recent change of officers or address

sources.citation: Entity verification against an official register, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.

notes: A company that is not in good standing, or whose registered office is a serviced address, is a fact about the entity. Neither is a finding about the people behind it.
